x, y, n = map(int, input().split())
import math
g = math.gcd(x, y)
x //= g
y //= g
min_res_num = 1000000000
min_res_den = 1

if y <= n:
    print(f"{x}/{y}")
else:
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        q = (x * i) // y
        if min_res_den * abs(x * i - q * y) < i * abs(x * min_res_den - min_res_num * y):
            min_res_num = q
            min_res_den = i
        q += 1
        if min_res_den * abs(x * i - q * y) < i * abs(x * min_res_den - min_res_num * y):
            min_res_num = q
            min_res_den = i
    print(f"{min_res_num}/{min_res_den}")
